name: App Manager
author: Uwe Bruckhaus
description: Launch · Group · Bind · Inspect: all your apps and plugins in one theme-aware popup. Type to launch; pull it wide and the list becomes cards with a group bar to filter and drag apps between groups; sort apps into your own groups or by origin; give any app or action a global shortcut on a key map that shows who owns every key; open App info with path, package, size and website. Resize, move, double-click to maximize. Widgets, plugins and tray apps have their own page.
